EFESO is a global pure player in operations strategy and performance improvement. Since 1980 it has built the business on operations, working side by side with leaders from boardroom to shop floor.

objects.canonical_name: More than 1500 projects a year in 75-plus countries
objects.description: Each year EFESO works with leaders from global brands, mid-sized companies, and private equity on more than 1,500 projects across 75-plus countries, with 1,000-plus operations specialists and more than 30 offices.
Official EFESO positioning uses the PHDS framework: Process, Human, Digital, and Sustainability, addressed together so change is lived rather than imposed.

objects.canonical_name: Current official website is canonical public positioning
objects.description: Live EFESO website pages are canonical for current public positioning, service families, industries, named public cases, and awards. Institutional decks remain historical or internal when they diverge and are versioned, not mixed silently.

objects.canonical_name: Driving output growth through operational excellence at Sif
objects.description: EFESO supported Sif in improving operational performance at its offshore foundation facility by strengthening machine reliability, reducing defects, and implementing structured performance management, with a 46 percent reduction in processing time.

objects.canonical_name: Reducing mining operating costs through operational excellence
objects.description: A mining company reduced operating costs by 15 percent by improving pit-to-plant coordination, maintenance effectiveness, supply chain performance, and operational accountability through a high-performance operating system.

objects.canonical_name: Delivering sustainable mining performance through operational excellence
objects.description: A mining company reduced operating costs by 20 percent through improvements in pit-to-plant planning, asset performance, maintenance reliability, supply chain management, and operational accountability.

objects.canonical_name: Transforming mining operations through predictive analytics
objects.description: A leading mining company improved mine planning efficiency, equipment utilization, and operational performance through integrated planning systems, predictive maintenance, and real-time monitoring technologies, with a 20 percent increase in productivity.

objects.canonical_name: Performance and agility transformation in sterile injectable manufacturing
objects.description: A leading pharmaceutical manufacturer transformed a sterile injectable site to become more agile, efficient, and competitive, with 10 million euros in recurring annual cost reduction.

objects.canonical_name: Standard work and performance control in chemicals maintenance
objects.description: Standardized processes transformed maintenance performance in chemicals operations, with 9.2 million dollars in cumulative savings and 12.5 million dollars in annualized benefits. Wrench time rose from 36 percent to 45 percent and backlog fell from 26 weeks to 16.

objects.canonical_name: Building a defense-compliant supply chain for rapid growth
objects.description: EFESO helped a high-growth aerospace manufacturer scale from pilot production to reliable output through compliance, supplier onboarding, and demand planning, freeing 11 percent of spend and lowering material costs by 20 percent.

objects.canonical_name: Accelerating product release through Lean Laboratory transformation
objects.description: A life-sciences client improved quality-control performance and operational efficiency through Lean Lab, reaching more than 90 percent release lead-time adherence.

objects.canonical_name: Scaling digital transformation through a global AI production platform
objects.description: A global food and beverage company scaled digital transformation across six sites with a connected AI production platform, implementing 16 use cases and generating more than 50 million euros in savings over five years.

objects.canonical_name: Executive digital control tower for global performance management
objects.description: A global industrial group reduced reporting delays by implementing a digital control tower, cutting data connection time from three to four days to 10 minutes and enabling real-time performance management across plants.

objects.canonical_name: Strengthening S and OP performance through a digital control tower
objects.description: A global manufacturer unified performance reporting with a digital control tower, improving S and OP visibility, reducing backlog by 90 percent, increasing OTIF by 30 percent, and increasing reporting frequency from monthly to weekly.

objects.canonical_name: Automating performance reporting for better decision-making
objects.description: A manufacturer automated reporting, eliminated data inconsistencies, reduced manual effort by 80 percent, and improved management visibility through business intelligence.

objects.canonical_name: Unlocking hidden factory capacity with a digital twin
objects.description: A medical-device manufacturer used digital twin simulation to unlock hidden factory capacity, with a 50 percent increase in production capacity with minimal investment, plus shorter lead times and avoided unnecessary capital spend.

objects.canonical_name: Predictive quality transformation for an automotive manufacturer
objects.description: An automotive manufacturer used AI-powered predictive quality to identify defects before inspection, reaching 95 percent accuracy in detecting scrap and rework risk before quality gates.

objects.canonical_name: Unlocking quality knowledge with generative AI
objects.description: A pharmaceutical company used generative AI to unlock quality knowledge, improve CAPA analysis, accelerate investigations, and strengthen compliance, with 75 percent more relevant search results.

objects.canonical_name: Reducing scrap and improving yield with AI-driven manufacturing analytics
objects.description: A global food manufacturer used AI-driven manufacturing analytics to reduce scrap by 23 percent and improve material yield by 6.5 percent.

objects.canonical_name: Optimizing inventory with AI-powered decision support
objects.description: EFESO helped a retail organization optimize inventory with AI, reducing excess stock by 23 percent, lowering costs by 8 percent, and improving service through continuous decision support.
EFESO helped a logistics organization improve forecast accuracy by 50 percent using AI, enabling data-driven workforce planning and delivering 500 thousand dollars in annual savings.

objects.canonical_name: Transforming production planning with AI-powered scheduling
objects.description: EFESO helped a pharmaceutical manufacturer transform production planning with AI, reducing planning time by 90 percent, improving equipment utilization, and delivering 1 million dollars in annual savings.

Twenty editions of Process Kaizen Engineer training in a Brazilian process-industry operation generated 62 million dollars in combined savings across maintenance, quality, and industrial engineering, with gains in availability, reliability, and operating efficiency. The client is not named in the member catalog.

Operational excellence waves in Brazilian bioenergy captured 19.8 million reais in benefits, with availability up 12 percent and production continuity up 35 percent, using WCOM, TPM, focused improvement, and reliability routines. The client is not named in the member catalog.

objects.canonical_name: WCOM and TPM in Home Care operations
objects.description: A multi-year operational excellence program across Home Care and Cleaning Products sites delivered 40 million dollars in cumulative savings, reduced waste by 50 percent, increased OEE by 25 percent, reduced customer complaints by 70 percent, and reduced occupational accidents by 60 percent. The client remains confidential.

Process-control-system implementation in a recycling operation delivered 7.5 million dollars in savings in six months, with productivity and utilization gains and a 58 percent reduction in unplanned downtime over two years. The client remains confidential.

EFESO has been recognized by European Supply Chain Media for supply-chain expertise and track record since 2015.

objects.canonical_name: Gartner Market Guide specialist in supply chain strategy

Reusable approach to design and implement a spare-parts warehouse operating model using ABCX segmentation, slow-moving and obsolescence control, and standard routines that reduce idle capital while protecting asset availability.

Reusable operating-system approach for high-volume precision manufacturing: daily management, SQDP, structured problem solving, quality excellence, and TPM, without treating a proposal as a completed case.

objects.canonical_name: Operations AI with S and OP and control tower
objects.description: Reusable staged approach that connects S and OP, S and OE, scheduling, manufacturing, and a control tower so digital and AI initiatives produce operational decisions rather than isolated tools.
Reusable implementation of daily performance management, cascading KPIs, and accountability routines so shop-floor and leadership reviews stay connected.
Reusable capability-building pattern that trains operations teams in structured problem solving so recurring issues are solved with A3, 8D, RCA, and related methods rather than firefighting.
Reusable coaching pattern that builds a governed continuous-improvement team so PDCA, A3, and Lean routines persist after the first wave of projects.

Reusable Process Kaizen Engineer academy pattern with five modules covering WCOM and problem solving, maintenance, quality, industrial engineering, and operational management, combining classroom sessions with shop-floor projects. A commercial proposal to run the academy is not a delivered result.
Reusable mapping of administrative and information flows using SIPOC, VSM, and Makigami to expose delays, handoffs, and opportunities before redesign.
Reusable review of the order cycle from order capture to receipt, using OTIF, on-time, in-full, and cycle-time indicators to locate delays without treating a proposal as a completed case.
Reusable warehouse strategy pattern: current-state mapping, future-state operating model, VSM, and implementation planning for inbound, storage, picking, packing, and outbound flows.
Reusable materials-planning approach using VSM, Makigami of the planning cycle, and ABCX inventory segmentation to reconnect demand, supply, and inventory decisions.
Reusable layout and automation-planning pattern for warehouse design, including AutoStore-type options. Planning an automation concept is not a delivered warehouse case.
